hero_abstract.alt: Abstract liquid glass bubbles representing data flow
hero_abstract.usage: Hero section background or floating element

patterns.tracing_beam: Use framer-motion to animate a gradient border around pricing/feature cards on hover

implementation_steps: Step 1: Update Tailwind Config with new fonts (Outfit), colors (indigo/purple), and animations.
Step 2: Install dependencies: framer-motion, @studio-freight/lenis (or lenis), clsx, tailwind-merge.
Step 3: Create base layout wrappers (GlassHeader, MeshBackground).
Step 4: Redesign Landing Page (Hero, Features Bento Grid, Pricing Tracing Beam).
Step 5: Redesign Dashboard (Floating Panels, Clean Tables, Glass Sidebar).
Step 6: Update Components (Buttons, Inputs, Cards) to match the 'Crystal Prism' style.

do: Use 'Manrope' for body text and small UI elements.
Use high-quality glassmorphism for sticky elements (Header, Sidebar).
Use the Blue-to-Purple gradient SPARINGLY (Buttons, Borders, Active States) - do not use full screen gradients.
Use generous padding (py-24, py-32) for landing page sections.
Use 1px borders with slate-100 or slate-200 for definition.
dont: DO NOT use generic centered text for everything.
DO NOT use dark mode by default (unless user toggles it).
DO NOT use dense layouts on the landing page (give it breath).
DO NOT use standard browser scroll (use Lenis).
